selections.sense: process of regaining health or ability after illness or injury
selections.levelRationale: Reuse the already selected recovery process while explaining a longer course of events.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Exact B1-P-060 means the same process; the approved B2 seed is not a new introduction.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine; recuperaciones for distinct processes; no predictable recovery schedule.
uncertainties: Retain B1-P-060 B1 against illustrative B2 seed. PCIC later thematic recovery uses do not by themselves justify releveling the same noun.

selections.sense: shared everyday life with other people
selections.levelRationale: Reuse shared-living vocabulary when describing competing needs.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Exact B1-P-138 and B1-S-060 already propose this same meaning.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine; convivencia con/entre; harmonious relations not required by definition.
uncertainties: Approved B2 seed versus actual B1 proposal; no duplicate sense for a longer relationship explanation.

selections.sense: connection that joins people through a relationship or shared commitment
selections.levelRationale: Name the tie itself when explaining why a relationship continues despite competing needs.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A2-P-032 relación is a broad interpersonal relation; vínculo emphasizes the connecting tie, with possible near-synonym overlap.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Masculine; vínculos; vínculo con/entre; no legal bond guarantee.
uncertainties: Original B2 seed; relation/tie lexical granularity and a plausible earlier B1 introduction remain open, not an official PCIC word assignment.

selections.sense: act beforehand to reduce the chance that a harmful event occurs
selections.levelRationale: Distinguish action before an illness or problem from treating its consequences.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A2 curar addresses an existing condition; preventing does not guarantee the event cannot happen.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Prevengo/previene/previne; prevention sense, not warn someone or prepare supplies.
uncertainties: Original B2 illness-prevention seed; PCIC advanced prevention noun/medical labels are comparison, not proof of verb first level. No preventive regimen or medical advice. B1-F-214/B1-S-189 proteger broadly prevent harm; distinguish prior risk reduction from shielding, with near-synonym/earlier-introduction review. No exact evitar selection in saved A1/A2/B1 manifests at this checkpoint.

selections.sense: part of the face above the eyebrows
selections.levelRationale: Specify this visible facial region rather than the whole head in a description.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Earlier cara/cabeza are broader; front-position/frontline meanings are different.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine la frente; frentes; masculine front/domain senses excluded.
uncertainties: PCIC1.1 B2, Wordfold introduction hypothesis; an earlier simple body label is a plausible alternative, not ruled out by specificity.

selections.sense: one of the two fleshy sides of the face below the eyes
selections.levelRationale: Distinguish the side of the face in a description of expression or contact.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Cara labels the whole face; this is a bounded location.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine; mejillas; no assumed rosy/healthy appearance.
uncertainties: PCIC1.1 B2; possible earlier everyday introduction explicitly open.

selections.sense: lower projecting part of the face below the mouth
selections.levelRationale: Identify the chin rather than mouth or jaw in an ordinary description.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Earlier boca is an opening, not this external lower-face location.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine; barbillas; mentón later near-synonym not a mandatory new sense.
uncertainties: PCIC1.1 B2; no anatomical specialist completeness claim.

selections.sense: line of hair above an eye
selections.levelRationale: Describe a visible feature that also helps convey expression.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Eye and general hair nouns do not identify the eyebrow.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine; cejas; no automatic aesthetic judgment.
selections.pronunciationNotes: CE-ja; j sound distinct from Slovak j.
uncertainties: PCIC1.1 B2; ordinary identification could justify an earlier level during global review.

selections.sense: hair growing along the edge of an eyelid
selections.levelRationale: Distinguish eyelashes from eyebrows in a physical description.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Ceja is above the eye; this is hair at the lid edge.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine; pestañas; computer-tab meaning excluded.
uncertainties: PCIC1.1 B2; digital tab is a genuinely different sense, not a synonym.

selections.sense: hair that has lost its usual pigment and appears white or grey
selections.levelRationale: Name an observed hair feature without treating age as a diagnosis.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Pelo is the general material; grey-hair feature does not define a person's age.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine; canas commonly plural; no requirement to dye or hide them.
uncertainties: PCIC1.1 B2; no assumption every grey hair belongs to an older person.

selections.sense: hard covering at the end of a finger or toe
selections.levelRationale: Identify the part referred to in grooming or a reported minor injury.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Dedo is the whole digit; nail is a distinct covering.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine; uñas; fingernail/toenail are contextual body-location variants.
uncertainties: PCIC1.1 B2; everyday hygiene use may support earlier introduction, not automatically rejected.

selections.sense: organ inside the skull central to nervous-system activity
selections.levelRationale: Recognize the organ in a general report without equating it to thought as an abstract concept.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Cabeza is the external body region; pensar is an action, not an organ.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Masculine; cerebros; clever-person figurative noun excluded.
uncertainties: PCIC1.1 B2; simplified lexical anatomy, not cognitive diagnosis.

selections.sense: internal abdominal organ involved in processing substances in the body
selections.levelRationale: Recognize an organ named in a reported test or general health explanation.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Estómago is a different organ, not a translation substitute.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Masculine; hígados; no exhaustive functions or medical-result interpretation.
uncertainties: PCIC1.1 B2; food liver H meaning must be separately scoped if selected.

selections.sense: one of the organs that filter blood and produce urine
selections.levelRationale: Identify the organ named in a general health report.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A2 espalda names an outside region, not an internal organ.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Masculine; riñones; no claims about symptoms or required anatomy for every person.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Ri-ÑÓN; initial r trilled, ñ; plural riñones loses accent.
uncertainties: PCIC1.1 B2; descriptive anatomy only, no diagnosis.

selections.sense: part of the digestive tract following the stomach
selections.levelRationale: Recognize the broad internal digestive location without a full organ taxonomy.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A2 estómago and B1 barriga are not this anatomical structure.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Masculine; intestinos; small/large modifiers are compositional subclasses unless separately needed.
uncertainties: PCIC1.1 B2; specialist bowel sections and treatment excluded.

selections.sense: framework of bones that supports the body
selections.levelRationale: Describe how bones are related as a whole.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1-P-022 hueso is one structure; this noun names the supporting framework.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Masculine; esqueletos; structural-outline figurative sense excluded.
uncertainties: PCIC1.1 B2; no requirement to list every bone.

selections.sense: series of vertebrae forming the spine
selections.levelRationale: Identify the spine in a reported posture or body account.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1-P-014/A2-P-010 espalda propose A2 for the back region; B1-C-035 building support and B1-W-108 table column are different meanings.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine; columna vertebral clarifies body sense; columns not counted by individual vertebra.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Co-LUM-na; preserve mn spelling with natural speech assimilation.
uncertainties: PCIC1.1 B2; skeletal versus architectural/table polysemy explicit.

selections.sense: one of the curved bones around the chest
selections.levelRationale: Distinguish a particular bone type in a reported injury description.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1 pecho is a region and hueso a hypernym, not this specific bone.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine; costillas; food rib/cut sense separate from person's anatomy.
uncertainties: PCIC1.1 B2; no diagnosis based on chest pain.

selections.sense: bundle of fibres carrying signals within the nervous system
selections.levelRationale: Recognize the bodily structure in an ordinary health explanation.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Nervioso emotional unease is not the anatomical bundle.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Masculine; nervios; emotional nerves meaning is separate.
uncertainties: PCIC1.1 B2; lexical recognition, no nerve-injury assessment.

selections.sense: connection between bones that permits or supports movement
selections.levelRationale: Use the generic joint label when the exact joint name is not the point.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Rodilla/tobillo name particular joints; this is their broader category.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine; articulaciones; speech articulation and mechanical connection need separate meaning decisions.
uncertainties: PCIC1.1 B2; connection category not a diagnosis or complete joint classification.

selections.sense: blood vessel that carries blood away from the heart
selections.levelRationale: Distinguish a vessel from the blood or heart in general reporting.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1 sangre is fluid and corazón is an organ; artery is a conduit.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine; arterias; main-road metaphor excluded.
uncertainties: PCIC1.1 B2; direction-based gloss avoids the false claim all arteries carry oxygenated blood.

selections.sense: strong tissue connecting a muscle to a bone
selections.levelRationale: Recognize the structure named in a reported movement injury.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1 músculo is contractile tissue; tendon connects rather than being the muscle itself.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Masculine; tendones; ligament is a different structure.
uncertainties: PCIC1.1 B2; no injury classification or physical manipulation.

selections.sense: liquid naturally produced in the mouth
selections.levelRationale: Name an ordinary bodily fluid when describing a perception or action.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Agua is a general substance and boca a location, neither names this secretion.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine generally noncount; no test interpretation.
uncertainties: PCIC1.2 B2; not evidence of a condition by itself.

selections.sense: drop of liquid from the eye
selections.levelRationale: Describe the visible result of crying or irritation.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1 llorar is the action; this is the liquid drop.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine; lágrimas; emotional and nonemotional causes share the physical noun.
uncertainties: PCIC1.2 B2; no assumption a tear proves sadness.

selections.sense: liquid released through the skin as perspiration
selections.levelRationale: Identify the bodily fluid separately from being hot or wet.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Calor is temperature/sensation; sweat is not merely any water on skin.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Masculine generally noncount; sudores for episodes.
uncertainties: PCIC1.2 B2; no medical inference from sweating.

selections.sense: movement of the face or body that conveys an expression or message
selections.levelRationale: Describe nonverbal expression while allowing cultural and contextual variation.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1 mirada is gaze; a gesture can involve other parts of the face/body.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Masculine; gestos; helpful deed/act sense separate.
selections.pronunciationNotes: GES-to; g before e has Spanish j sound.
uncertainties: PCIC1.2 B2; no fixed universal reading of a gesture.

selections.sense: visible appearance of the face that conveys a feeling or attitude
selections.levelRationale: Describe a facial expression without claiming to know hidden motives.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1-F-289 expresión verbal wording is different; aspecto is broader outward appearance.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine; expresiones; expresión facial clarifies selection.
uncertainties: PCIC1.2 B2; inferred feeling must remain tentative, not mind reading.

selections.sense: having no sight or very limited sight
selections.levelRationale: Understand an optional self-description of visual disability.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Poor visibility in a place and closed eyes are not a person's blindness.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Ciego/ciega; person-first or identity-first wording follows person's preference; no severity diagnosis.
selections.pronunciationNotes: CIE-go; ie diphthong and hard g before o.
uncertainties: PCIC1.2 B2; neutral descriptor, not insult or automatically complete absence of all visual perception.

selections.sense: having substantial or complete hearing loss
selections.levelRationale: Recognize optional self-description and communication-access needs.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A quiet place or not listening deliberately is not deafness.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Sordo/sorda; identity and language preferences vary; no ability assumption.
uncertainties: PCIC1.2 B2; do not equate deafness with inability to speak or understand.

selections.sense: sense or ability through which a person sees
selections.levelRationale: Distinguish visual ability from the eye organ or an attractive view.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: Earlier ojo is an organ and ver an action; faculty noun is separately selected.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Feminine; la vista; scenery, visit and legal hearing meanings excluded.
uncertainties: PCIC2.3 B2; faculty versus act/organ granularity explicit.

selections.sense: sense or ability through which a person hears
selections.levelRationale: Distinguish hearing ability from the ear as an anatomical location.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A2-P-083 oído explicitly names organ/inner-ear body location; this is the sensory faculty.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Masculine; el oído; plural oídos usually organs, not automatically the faculty.
uncertainties: PCIC2.3 B2; different faculty sense may have earlier introduction. A2-P-083 is a new proposed organ sense with no baseline entry ID, not an existing runtime identity.

selections.sense: sense through which flavours are perceived
selections.levelRationale: Name the sensory faculty rather than a particular flavour or preference.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1-P-053 sabor is perceived quality; liking/taste preference is a different gusto.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Masculine; el gusto; plural gustos normally preferences, not this faculty.
uncertainties: PCIC2.3 B2; no new noun for every food example.

selections.sense: sense through which contact and texture are perceived
selections.levelRationale: Name the faculty underlying a tactile description.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1 tocar contact action and suave texture quality do not name the sensory faculty.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Masculine; el tacto; social tact/discretion meaning excluded.
selections.pronunciationNotes: TAC-to; preserve ct cluster in careful speech.
uncertainties: PCIC2.3 B2; faculty versus considerate manner explicitly different.

selections.sense: sense through which smells are perceived
selections.levelRationale: Distinguish the sensory faculty from a smell and from the nose.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1 olor is the quality and oler the perception action; nariz is the organ.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Masculine; el olfato; figurative instinct excluded.
uncertainties: PCIC2.3 B2; no diagnosis from altered smell.

selections.sense: raise the upper body or rise from a lying or seated position
selections.levelRationale: Describe a bodily position change distinct from getting out of bed as routine.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1 levantarse and B1 tumbarse supply broader rise/lie contrasts; B1-W-086 incorporarse joins an activity, not posture.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Pronominal incorporarse; incorporarse en la cama; not incorporation into employment.
uncertainties: PCIC1.3 B2; earlier general rise parent may subsume this construction, requiring granularity decision.

selections.sense: place one body part over another in a crossed position
selections.levelRationale: Describe crossed arms or legs without confusing this with traversing a space.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1-T-097/A2-F-073 cruzar are crossing from side to side, with their A1/A2 conflict unchanged.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Cruzar los brazos/las piernas; crucé spelling; body-part articles rather than compulsory possessives.
selections.pronunciationNotes: Cru-ZAR; crucé cru-CÉ, c/z distinction or seseo.
uncertainties: PCIC1.3 B2; physical crossing parent vs distinct arrangement sense is explicit global review.

selections.sense: with the knees resting on a supporting surface
selections.levelRationale: Name a posture in an account without requiring a medical interpretation.
selections.lowerLevelContrast: B1-P-004 rodilla names the joint; A1 de pie and seated postures do not name kneeling.
selections.register: neutral descriptive; optional self-report and attributed claims
selections.region: Pan-Hispanic core with explicit variants; es-ES audio target
selections.formNotes: Fixed plural rodillas in de rodillas; ponerse/estar de rodillas share posture phrase.
selections.pronunciationNotes: De ro-DI-llas; ll follows chosen regional model.
uncertainties: PCIC1.3 B2; phrase vs productive preposition+noun granularity open.

selections.sense: with the back facing a person or reference point
